description: Envelope seal (SPEC §2.3, §3). tag = "carom/v1/env"; H = [u64(v), msg_id, from, to_joined, collapse_or_empty, u64(ttl_s)] with to_joined = lp(to[0]) || lp(to[1]) || ...; aad = lp(tag) || lp(H[0]) || ... || lp(u64(kv)) || lp(salt); ct = ChaCha20-Poly1305(msg_key(K, salt), nonce = 12 zero bytes, aad, plaintext); sig = Ed25519(sign_sk, aad || lp(ct)). Payload JSON is padded with spaces (SPEC §3.1); plaintext_hex is the exact padded plaintext. Opening with sender_sign_pub and group_key MUST yield plaintext_hex. Signatures are Ed25519 per RFC 8032 and deterministic ("deterministic_rfc8032"). Implementations whose signer is randomized (e.g. CryptoKit) MUST check them by verification, not by byte comparison.
